# Tool-selection evaluation fixtures

Generated by `scripts/tool-selection/generate_fixtures.py --seed 20260920` (deterministic).

| File | Contents |
| --- | --- |
| `catalog.jsonl` | 1,500 tools. The first 100 are curated cards (`"curated": true`): 50 capability families × a public/internal source, each with a distinct purpose, suitability, unsuitability and input schema. The remaining 1,400 (`"curated": false`) exist only to measure 1,500/10,000-item behaviour and must not be used alone to judge retrieval quality. |
| `scenarios.jsonl` | 150 scenario-family requests with a gold tool set, plus 20 `"noMatch": true` requests with an empty gold set (170 total). |
| `corrections.jsonl` | 100 correction pairs (50 families × project/persistent and conversation/once), each with the conditions under which it must and must not apply. |
| `split.json` | Family-level split: development 60%, validation 20%, held-out 20% by seed. Paraphrases never cross splits. |

The split unit is the scenario family. Labels are fixed before measuring: a run must not rewrite
the gold tool to match whatever the implementation returned.

`lane=mock` (hash embedding/reranker) exercises the pipeline; `lane=live` requires the pinned
local models from `scripts/tool-selection/prepare_models.py` and is the only lane that can satisfy
the Recall@30 ≥ 95% / Hit@5 ≥ 90% targets.
